summary: Kootenai County tower on Coeur d'Alene NF: 30-ft pole tower with L-4 cab built 1931, destroyed about 1950; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Idaho Fire Lookouts spells the name Jacknife; the record and the other sources use Jackknife. Do not confuse with the Lakeview Lookout, a separate page on idahofirelookouts.com (1931 L-4 on a 40-ft pole tower, destroyed 1956). A USFS Idaho Panhandle NF social post (facebook.com/USFSIPNF) shows a circa-1932 photo of this tower; not cited because it is a social post, but it is a photo lead. Brief record matches the listing row. No source found describes the site today.
